units: dB(A) re digital full scale (dBFS(A)), uncalibrated; relative comparisons only

method.mapping: sections.json depart/arrive (phyphox experiment time) -> audio s via sync.sensor_to_audio (wall time; R4 pauses respected). 1-s bins whose centre lies in [a0, a1); bins inside a phyphox pause (no sensor data, phone handled) are dropped.
method.edge_check: coarse consistency check only (resolves the sync to ~+-5-10 s): offset of the quiet dip from each sensor arrival/departure within +-10 s; hits at the window edge = no dip found

variants.LAeq: energy mean of 1-s LAeq over the section
variants.core_: same, first/last 10 s dropped (accel/brake, sync error)
variants.top25_LAeq: energy mean of the loudest 25% of seconds (length-neutral)
variants.LAeq_limiter_ub: 1-s LAeq + crest_deficit_db (indicative upper bound without limiter)
variants.n_s_within6_of_max: seconds within 6 dB of the section-run max 1-s LAeq

method.placement_exclusion: section-run excluded from averages when >= 25% of it is covered by qc.json floor_like_placement flags
method.trips: qc.json split_runs pair R1 + R1.5 as one logical trip (separate audio files)

verdict.justification: LST-BTH is louder than BTH-MLE in 5/5 placement-ok trips (mean within-trip difference +0.60 dB, range +0.25 to +1.21; one-sided sign test p=0.031). The difference is below 1 dB, i.e. inside the Voice Memos limiter compression (~1-3 dB) and the run-to-run sd of a section (0.4-0.8 dB). Not robust across variants: LAeq_1s_mean, LAeq_limiter_ub do not agree in every trip. Absolute levels are uncalibrated dBFS(A), so nothing here can be compared with TfL's 92.8 dB.

victoria_within_run.note: R0 only (n=1). Consistent in direction with TfL's FOI figure ranking Green Park-Victoria loudest on the network (92.9 dB), but a single run and within processing uncertainty; the FOI ranking is network-wide, not a comparison with Green Park-Oxford Circus.
